title: 2-wide 4-input AND-OR-INVERT gates

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments and function tables)
TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 6 (gate and flip-flop data sheets)

pins.name: X
pins.text: expander node: connect to the X output of up to four 74H60 or one 74H62 expander; leave open if not used

pins.name: X'
pins.text: expander node: connect to the X-bar output of the expander; leave open if not used

functions.formula: Y = NOT ((A AND B AND C AND D) OR (E AND F AND G AND H) OR X)
functions.text: Y is low when ABCD are all high, or EFGH are all high, or an expander on X/X' is true (X = output of a 74H60 or 74H62).

electrical.notes: Designed for use with up to four 74H60 expanders or one 74H62 expander.

unknown: Maximum propagation delay with 15 pF on the expander node: the table gives typical values only.
notes: The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
